recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-17973 unless FM separately decides to revise the current benefitPeriod wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17973 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request asking to add ExplanationOfBenefit.benefitPeriod before benefitBalance as a 0..1 Period for when specified benefits are applicable, motivated by multi-year coverages and annual benefit tables.
initial_application: The change was applied historically in commit 89bb47c31d84c7cc3fb753e5408806226f62d395, a multi-issue ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheet commit that added benefitPeriod with 0..1 cardinality, Period type, definition, requirements, and comment. The 2021 source refactor commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved the element in source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists ExplanationOfBenefit as a current resource, assigns it to FM, maps its abbreviation, and marks it approved. Current source places benefitPeriod immediately before benefitBalance with min 0, max 1, type Period, short text 'When the benefits are applicable', definition 'The term of the benefits documented in this response.', and the same annual-benefit/multi-year-coverage rationale. Searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion and no conflicting later core Jira decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Exact source wording does not need to be changed to the original Jira phrasing because the current element preserves the requested semantics and a wording-only edit would be cosmetic.
